page_title: HEI 0-3 MON | Heidenheim v B. Monchengladbach 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Soren Storks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+1' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) makes a strong challenge and Soren Storks blows for a foul.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
89' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
88' Rough tackle by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Kevin Muller pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
82' 4:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Robin Hack.
78' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Joe Scally.
74' A dangerous looking corner kick from Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is cleared to safety by the defence.
74' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Leo Scienza (Heidenheim), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
71' Paul Wanner will be replaced by Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim).
71' The free kick is delivered by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
71' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Soren Storks blows for a foul.
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
69' The goal by B. Monchengladbach won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
68' The B. Monchengladbach players halt their celebrations as referee Soren Storks makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

67' Goal! Philipp Sander shows great vision to find Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 0:4.
67' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
66' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Leo Scienza (Heidenheim). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
65' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Tiago Pereira Cardoso is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
64' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is replacing Jonas Fohrenbach.
62' Here is a change. Alassane Plea is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
62' Here comes a substitution. Nathan Ngoumou is given a rest as he is replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
61' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
59' 0 - 3 Goal! Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) finds some space for a shot from the edge of the box and his attempt goes low inside the right post. Fantastic finish.
58' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
57' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
57' Heidenheim earn a corner.
53' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from B. Monchengladbach was in an offside position.
52' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

49' This should have been a goal! Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) takes a mid-range free kick and his effort flies straight as an arrow, but crashes against the crossbar. The keeper only turned his head and stared at the ball.
49' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card.
49' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card.
46' Half-time substitution. Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) is replaced by Adrian Beck.
46' Half-time substitution. Gerardo Seoane decided to make a change. Lukas Ullrich is replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
46' The game is over for Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim). Marvin Pieringer comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

44' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
44' Heidenheim win a corner.

44' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
41' Soren Storks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) and blew his whistle.
40' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
40' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
39' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
35' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
33' Here comes a substitution. Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Luca Kerber.
30' A pass from Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is intercepted by Kevin Muller and the move breaks down.
29' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
29' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
25' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
22' Soren Storks has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
20' B. Monchengladbach control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

18' 0 - 2 Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Alassane Plea. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the top right corner via the woodwork. 0:2!
16' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' Dangerous play by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach). Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) has a goal ruled out for offside!
9' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Julian Weigl, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
6' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
6' The free kick into the penalty area from Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.
5' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) commits a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are awarded the free kick.
2' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Soren Storks.
